Author: Solona
Name: Proteus
Description: Overlay compositor for Penumbra. Discovers mods with a Proteus/ sidecar, composites their overlay textures in Penumbra priority order, and maintains a single managed mod at priority 999. Type /proteus to open the status window, or /proteus config for settings.
Punchline: Automatic overlay compositor for Penumbra mods
Changelog: Add toggles to any mod. Equip mods as accessories without using a gear slot.
